g.text: Step 0 — initial state, before the loop
Iterate strs left to right; for each s, compute a 26-length letter-count key.
count(non-zero) = a:1, e:1, t:1 -> key = K1 = tuple(count)
K1 not in res yet -> defaultdict creates a new empty list, appends "eat".
count(non-zero) = a:1, e:1, t:1 -> key = K1 (same as "eat")
K1 already in res -> match found! Append "tea" to the existing K1 bucket.
count(non-zero) = a:1, n:1, t:1 -> key = K2 (new, different from K1)
K2 not in res yet -> defaultdict creates a new empty list, appends "tan".
count(non-zero) = a:1, e:1, t:1 -> key = K1 (same as "eat"/"tea")
K1 already in res -> match found! Append "ate" to the existing K1 bucket.
count(non-zero) = a:1, n:1, t:1 -> key = K2 (same as "tan")
K2 already in res -> match found! Append "nat" to the existing K2 bucket.
count(non-zero) = a:1, b:1, t:1 -> key = K3 (new, distinct from K1/K2)
K3 not in res yet -> defaultdict creates a new empty list, appends "bat".
Result: `[["eat","tea","ate"], ["tan","nat"], ["bat"]]` (group order may vary, contents match)
